specials.INACTIVE: **INACTIVE** — whichever character is not currently active (`CHARACTER = 0x53`).
specials.LAST_ENTITY: **LAST_ENTITY** — the most recently spawned or referenced entity (`CHARACTER = 0x2d`). Commonly used inside enemy scripts.
specials.SCRIPT_OWNER: **SCRIPT_OWNER** — the entity that owns the running script (`CHARACTER = 0x2e`).
specials.SCRIPT_TARGET: **SCRIPT_TARGET** — the entity passed as the target to the running script.
specials.BOY_ENTITY: **BOY_ENTITY** — boy addressed as an entity (not a character slot).
